item.title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
item.description: arXiv:2610.19095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chatbot Arena ranks language models with the Bradley-Terry model, which gives each model one score and so assumes Luce's choice axiom. Choice theory predicts where this fails: near-copies are told apart more decisively than their scores imply.
